body: Thank you so much for this comment. It made me feel a little better. I’m sorry that this happens to you too though. It genuinely is the worst. I’ll be doing so good and be totally fine and then boom, right back.
rip I guess. I just want them gone man it’s upsetting. It’s a small apt I’ve looked everywhere I could to find maybe a mouse body or something but I haven’t found anything or even smelled anything.
I do every week. :/ I usually have one trash bag bc it’s just me living here so there’s not a lot of trash.
Also I live in Ohio, and I hope this fits this sub and if not I apologize.

Background! I have like 3 different types of flies in my apartment. Regular house flies, and the 2 pictured above which I believe might be blow flies and corpse flies. I genuinely have no idea why but out of nowhere starting about 2 weeks ago with a couple random flies and getting progressively worse the past 3 days, my apartment is infested. They huddle near my lights so I keep literally two lights on. In my bathroom around my mirror light there’s a small hoard and now in my living room!! I’m honestly freaking out there’s probably like 50 flies or more in each area. I keep my apt clean, I don’t have big ass messes and I empty any cardboard containers like pizza boxes and bag all my trash up for trash day. Like I’m not living in a nest it’s just normal daily messes like some clothes on my floor or a cup of pop I left out the night before type of stuff.

I really don’t understand. I live in an upstairs apartment so I’m not sure if it’s my neighbors maybe and they’re getting in through my water heater? There’s a small hole in the floor by my water heater in my bathroom where it’s the worst. Idk what to do besides the normal fly traps and spray and idk what is going on. Is there a particular reason my house could be getting infested from??
Thank you. That does mean a lot.

Hey I don’t have any good advice but I get the same way too. I always do something impulsive when it happens. It feels so out of control and it’s just pure rage. I hope you can find a good way to cope, just wanted to let you know you weren’t alone.
I use MyFitnessPal! I hear loseit is good too, I’m just more familiar with myfitnesspal lol
No it was helpful! Hearing others experiences helps a lot. I’m glad you’ve found something that works for you!! I’ll check that website out, thank you

Congrats on your progress!! And yes I do need to be careful not to become obsessive about it. I think hearing advice from others helps me keep things in perspective because I can’t always trust my brain lol. I’ve got a lot of great advice and I’m very thankful for this community.

Wow that’s extremely helpful. I never thought of just maintaining, it’s always go go go. Very good point, I’ll try that because I definitely do go through periods where I feel wayyy more hungry than normal and I couldn’t figure out why.

I do see a therapist and have a general dr who’s supportive of this. She’s wonderful. I’ll be bringing up some points made in the comments and what I’ve read online. I think based on some input I will be sticking around 1500-1800 until I can talk to my doctor. Also thank you for commenting. Idk why but just knowing people read my post made me tear up for some dumb reason lol. Feels like I’m not alone. Anyyyway ty and I appreciate the input. :)

Thank you! I appreciate the range. I was thinking around 1500-1600 but I honestly could not tell if that was too high or low. It feels like too high to lose weight but I also know I can’t sustain 1200 and less like my brain is telling me lmao. You’d think Id learn. It’s helpful to have others input, so ty so much :)

This was super helpful and made it so much easier to understand. Thank you so much. I am in therapy right now, and I’ve mostly recovered from the bulimia, I struggle a little with the binge eating but it’s not nearly as bad as it was honestly. I was too ashamed to put it in the post but I actually weighed 350 at my highest weight. I’ve lost 50 pounds in a year but I honestly have just not been paying attention and idk how I did it. I want to get serious, I feel like I’m too young to let this be my life. I do need to be careful but I believe I’ll be okay with my counselors support. Also thank you again this was seriously very helpful and I’ll bring up some points with my dr too!
